name: Wander Wombat
description: Wander Wombat is a palm-sized explorer with a squishable belly and a felt backpack stuffed with snack crumbs and tiny maps. It loves aisle-seat optimism, dramatic passport stamps, and sending postcard doodles from pocket level. Book this fuzzball a trip and expect cheerful trip reports, souvenir sticker swaps, and heroic naps in cup holders.

name: Socktopus
description: Socktopus is an eight-armed cutie sewn from mismatched travel socks, with buttony suckers and a permanent “I can hold your snacks” grin. It clings to windows, tray tables, and hearts, collecting tiny baggage tags and stamping a miniature passport with every wiggle. Book this clingy companion for chaos-free layovers, emergency giggles, and heroic cup-holder hugs.

name: Mochi Yeti
description: Mochi Yeti is a dumpling-sized snow snuggle with velvety fluff, rosy cheeks, and a pocket scarf that smells like hotel hot chocolate. It adores airport breezes, hotel ice machines, and writing polite reviews for thermostats, collecting snowflake stamps in a tiny passport. Book this frosty friend for cozy trip pics, elevator-button high-fives, and heroic rescues of runaway marshmallows.

name: Pretzel Pigeon
description: Pretzel Pigeon is a pocket-sized city birb with a plush pretzel twist belly, shiny bead eyes, and a jaunty felt flight cap. It adores food-court layovers, cooing polite boarding calls, and filing detailed crumb reviews in its micro passport. Book this carb-curious cutie for photo ops on suitcase handles, crumb diplomacy, and heroic rescues of runaway popcorn.

name: Luggage Ladybug
description: Luggage Ladybug is a glossy, polka-dotted pocket pal with a zippered shell that hides emergency stickers and crumb snacks. It adores riding the baggage carousel like a merry-go-round, clicking zippers politely, and stamping a dotted passport after every gate giggle. Book this cheerful beetle for handle-top photo shoots, zipper diplomacy with grumpy suitcases, and heroic rescues of runaway bag tags.

name: Ticket Tortoise
description: Ticket Tortoise is a palm-sized plush with a flip-top felt shell hiding miniature boarding passes and a nubbin pencil. It worships timetables, declares every moving walkway a victory lap, and politely reminds clouds to be on time. Book this punctual peanut for gate-side pep talks, seat-number serenades, and heroic shell-bumps that nudge sleepy coffees into bravery.

name: Compass Capy
description: Compass Capy is a palm-plush capybara with a twinkly chest compass that wiggles toward snacks and scenic detours. It hums tiny “brmp” songs on moving walkways, smooths wrinkly maps with its big potato paws, and insists every window seat needs a sunbeam inspection. Book this mellow navigator for soothing gate-line vibes, snack-route optimization, and heroic stares that calm even the silliest turbulence.

name: Orbit Otter
description: Orbit Otter is a palm-sized plush astronaut-otter with a satin star-map belly and a tail that snaps around neck pillows like a seatbelt. It adores window-seat cloud counting, bathtub "splash audits," and practicing zero-gravity floats on rolling suitcases. Book this buoyant bean for cosmic gate selfies, floaty lounge naps, and very serious inspections of tiny hotel rubber ducks.

name: Cloud Corgi
description: Cloud Corgi is a loaf-sized plush pilot with button-bright eyes, a tiny felt captain hat, and a wag that sounds like gentle takeoff whooshes. It herds stray snacks into neat formations, issues polite boop-youre-cleared to every cloud, and naps only at cruising cuddle altitude. Book this stubby skipper for window-seat wiggle dances, gate-line morale boosts, and heroic rescues of runaway neck pillows.

name: Postcard Pigeon
description: Postcard Pigeon is a plush pocket courier with a tiny felt mail satchel stuffed with micro-postcards and stamp stickers. It coos pep-notes to nervous snacks, practices dignified head-bobs at departure boards, and insists every layover deserves a quick doodle of a heroic pretzel. Reserve this chirpy chum for aisle-rail perch photos, seatmate shout-outs delivered by beak, and triumphant flap-salutes when your luggage actually arrives.

name: Cabin Kraken
description: Cabin Kraken is a pocket-plush cephalopod who thinks zippers are sea-gates and boarding passes are treasure maps. With eight polite felt tentacles, it tidies cables, hugs suitcase handles, and whispers “release the snacks” before every takeoff. Book this cuddle captain for gate-side pep rumbles, heroic zipper rescues, and soothing thrum-thrum hugs when clouds get wobbly.

name: Map Moth
description: Map Moth is a pocket-plush night navigator with crinkly atlas wings and gentle glow-in-the-dark antennae. It flutters toward cozy gate lights, reads departure boards with very serious wiggles, and tucks nervous snacks under its wings until turbulence forgets your row exists. Reserve this moon-soft bean for red-eye bravery, gate-change wiggle alerts, and tray-table shadow shows that end in a triumphant squeak.

name: Transit Tortoise
description: Transit Tortoise is a pocket-plush plodder with a patchwork map shell and teeny felt sneakers it wears for “moving walkway marathons.” It tucks your boarding pass under its shell, hums a calm-on, carry-on lullaby, and declares every delay a “bonus snack intermission.” Book this steady bean for patient gate hangs, victory nods at carousel reunions, and measured strides toward adventure.

name: Gate Gnome
description: Gate Gnome is a palm-sized plush runway marshal with a fluffy felt beard, tiny neon safety vest, and two glowsticky wand-waves that say “right this sway.” It lines up snacks into perfect taxiways, whispers “gnome worries” to jittery carry-ons, and points your courage toward Boarding Zone Brave. Book this bearded bean for preboard pep hops, lost-seat treasure hunts, and heroic high-vis hugs when delays try to steal your sparkle.

name: Carousel Capybara
description: Carousel Capybara is a palm-sized plush patience coach who treats baggage carousels like gentle rivers of reunion. It noms air anxiously (very supportive), awards "Bag of the Day" stickers, and hums a soft 'dum-dum-claim' anthem until your suitcase wobbles home for a snuggle selfie.

name: Jet Puffin
description: Jet Puffin is a pocket-plush bird captain with felt flippers, a tiny aviator cap, and a beak that peeps "depart!" whenever snacks appear. It taps your boarding pass like a bravery stamp, declares every seat a window seat (emotionally), and nests on tray tables to block turbulence gremlins with serious fluff. Book this sky bean for gate-waddle pep talks, righteous overhead-bin pointing, and triumphant beak clacks when wheels kiss runway.

name: Compass Corgi
description: Compass Corgi is a palm-sized plush pathfinder with a spinny felt compass collar and a wag calibrated to “this way, friend.” It herds runaway worries back into your carry-on, noses out the comfiest view seat (emotionally verified), and awards brave-traveler boops before leading tiny toe-tap parades to your gate. Book this stubby navigator for gate-change giggles, aisle-zoom pep trots, and triumphant tail-wags when wheels whisper home.

name: Outlet Otter
description: Outlet Otter is a palm-sized power pal with minky fur, felt whiskers, and a teeny utility belt of cable loops. It scoots up to wall sockets with a polite “watt’s up,” shares the charge, issues “power nap permits,” and flipper-claps when your battery hits 100%—logging it in its tiny ledger as “juice-tice served.”

name: Snack Yeti
description: Snack Yeti is a pocket-sized fluff mountaineer who treats terminals like tasty trailheads. With a mini lunchbox backpack and crumb-detecting whiskers, it scouts free samples, secures napkins, and plants a tiny flag atop any pretzel pile it conquers. Expect morale-boosting “yum yodels,” diplomatic snack swaps, and triumphant high-fives with its marshmallowy mitts when gate hunger gets gnarly.

name: Tram Ham
description: Tram Ham is a pocket-sized pig conductor who lives for the hush-whoosh between terminals. With a felt cap, a teensy bell, and a timetable belly, it snout-punches imaginary tickets and squeaks “ding-ding, doors closing (emotionally)” while you find your balance. Book this rolling rascal for transfer-confidence, pole-hug pep talks, and celebratory “last stop, yay!” oinks when your shuttle glides to the right gate.

name: Queue Quokka
description: Queue Quokka is a palm-sized plush morale marshal with a sun-bright grin and a tiny felt lanyard that reads “Very Important Friend.” It turns any line into a mini parade, issuing sparkle-stamp high-fives, practicing patient wiggles, and softly declaring “no cuts, only cuddles” until your turn arrives. Book this grin machine for queue-pep, scanner-beep victory winks, and triumphant tail twizzles when the rope finally swooshes open.

name: Terminal Tarsier
description: Terminal Tarsier is a pocket-sized plush air-traffic cheerleader with saucer eyes and a neon vest two sizes too proud. It reads microscopic gate signs, twitches its tiny marshalling wands into encouraging arrows, and softly squeaks “rotate... confidence up” when turbulence jitters try a takeover. Book this bright-eyed buddy for sign-decoding pep, window-watching wonder, and victorious ear-perks when your name blinks from “standby” to “seated.”

name: Socktopus
description: Socktopus is a pocket-sized octo-buddy with velcro “suckers” and a clothespin crown, sworn to reunite runaway socks. It whispers “pair patrol!” then wriggles into suitcase corners, chair shadows, and laundry limbo, emerging with dramatic twirls and triumphant “it matches!” wiggles. Book this eight-hug hero for cozy-foot confidence, zipper-guard duty, and emergency mitten diplomacy mid-journey.

name: Orbit Otter
description: Orbit Otter is a pocket-sized adventure otter who treats moving walkways like rivers of destiny. Wearing a tiny captain’s scarf and a wrist-compass, it slide-coaches your stride with cheerful “whoosh!”s, pointing its paw when it’s time to hop off. Book this glide guide for pace pep, gate-correcting wiggles, and triumphant paw-claps when you dismount right where you meant to be.

name: Carousel Capy
description: Carousel Capy is a palm-sized capybara lifeguard for luggage rivers, wearing a tiny safety vest and a pea-sized whistle. It rides the carousel like a lazy float, nudging your bag with its soft nose and chirping, "claim your calm!" while you wave. Book this mellow marshmallow for bag-spotting pep, delayed-baggage zen, and triumphant tail-plop celebrations when your suitcase finally sails by.

name: Snack Yak
description: Snack Yak is a palm-sized plush trail-blazer with fluffy horns and tiny saddlebag panniers full of morale munchies. It sniffs out water fountains, schedules “nibble o’clock,” and whispers “snack smart, wander far” as it jingles its little bell. Book this munch mentor for aisle-seat picnic prep, zipper-pocket pep talks, and triumphant crumb-dances when the snack cart rounds the corner.

name: Queue Quokka
description: Queue Quokka is a pocket-sized line-leader with a polka-dot pennant and a grin that cancels sighs. It boops your spot with its soft tail, starts the shuffle-shuffle shimmy, and awards teeny patience-star stickers for heroic not-line-hopping. Book this merry marshal for boarding-lane bravery, check-in zen, and triumphant cheek-puff squeaks when the rope finally drops.

name: Outlet Owl
description: Outlet Owl is a palm-sized power scout with glow-in-the-dark beak and grippy sock-feet. It hoots, “whooo’s got juice?” then points out hidden plugs behind planters, under seats, and on the back of gate kiosks, unspooling a tiny cable lasso with smug twinkle eyes. Book this wattage watchdog for cord-calming perch patrol, civilized share-negotiations, and triumphant wing-waggles when every device hits 100%.

name: Nap Newt
description: Nap Newt is a pocket-sized snooze scout with a lavender eye mask and a roll‑up cloud blanket. It sniffs out sunbeam seats and hush-hollows, hums tiny lullaby bloops, and sets a smugly gentle alarm so you wake right before boarding. Book this doze coach for layover lulls, power-nap courage, and triumphant slow‑blink confetti when you stretch exactly on time.

name: Stamp Shrimp
description: Stamp Shrimp is a palm-sized passport pixie with a bellhop hat and an inkpad tail. It preps your docs with clickety-claw finesse, practices your “hello” in three squeaks, and makes dramatic ker-CHUNK sound effects for every real stamp. Book this border buddy for visa-line valor, form-filling courage, and triumphant tail-swish confetti when the officer nods and slides your passport back.

name: Bin Buddy
description: Bin Buddy is a pocket-sized overhead-bin wrangler with a tiny reflective vest, magnetic mittens, and a tape‑measure tongue. It Tetris-fits bags, negotiates gentle handle hugs, and chirps, “wheels-in, world wins!” with absurdly brave jazz-hands. Book this stowage coach for calm aisle choreography, zipper zen, and triumphant click-click confetti when the bin shuts with room to spare.

name: Snack Yak
description: Snack Yak is a palm-sized pantry pathfinder with a napkin cape and a ketchup-clip bandolier. It sniffs out legendary terminal snacks, hoof-drums when a fresh tray drops, and deploys its polite “crumb-brrrr” snout to tidy the table. Book this munch buddy for gate-change grazing, sauce safety, and triumphant tiny bell dings when you score the last warm pretzel.

name: Echo Gecko
description: Echo Gecko is a pocket-sized PA translator with suction-cup toes, a neon safety vest, and a tiny flip-sign tail. It clings near speakers, turns garbled announcements into crisp chirps and cartoony cue-cards, and points your feet toward the right gate like a smug traffic cone. Bring this chatter coach for PA-puzzle bravery and triumphant tiny ding-ding! when you arrive calm and exactly where you belong.

name: Tray Jay
description: Tray Jay is a pocket-sized queue coach with a stack of tiny nesting trays and a whistle you can barely hear. It lines up your laptop, liquids, and oops-pockets like a choreographed bird ballet, then chirps a proud “no-beep!” as you glide through screening. Book this calm captain for zipper zen, belt-loop bravery, and triumphant feather-flutter confetti when your tray returns empty and your smile returns full.

name: Clock Croc
description: Clock Croc is a palm-sized time‑zone tamer in stripy pajamas with a wind‑up belly clock and a flip‑flop sun‑moon sign. It tick‑tock coaches water sips, stretch breaks, and blink-at-sunlight bravery, then grins whenever you skip 3 a.m. doom‑scrolling. Expect synchronized yawns with locals and a tiny snout snap of approval when you power-nap exactly 17 minutes.

name: Stamp Champ
description: Stamp Champ is a thumb-sized passport pal with a glittery belt of tiny ink pads and a foam-fist stamper it wields like a mic. It flips to the right page, fluffs your form edges, and chants “stamp‑a‑lam!” as the ink lands, then showers two confetti specks and a victory wink. Book this cheer captain for paperwork pep, queue calm, and triumphant tiny thump‑thump when your passport gets its glorious bop.

name: Bin Lynx
description: Bin Lynx is a palm-sized overhead-bin whisperer with magnetic paws, tufted ears, and a teeny reflective vest sprinkled like cabin stars. It tiptoes up the aisle, Tetris-tilts roller bags, and tags “wheels-in, zips-out” with a smug whisker twitch. Book this furry stow pro for bin-peace treaties, soft paw shuffles, and a triumphant tiny clink‑clink when every bag nests snug and nobody plays suitcase musical chairs.

name: Carousel Koala
description: Carousel Koala is a palm-sized bag-spotter with velcro paws, a zebra-striped safety sash, and a pop-up periscope eye. It clings to your suitcase handle, scans the spinning parade, and chirps “that’s yours!” just before your bag whizzes by, then delivers a fuzzy magnet-hug. Book this spin whisperer for calm claim vibes and a triumphant tiny whirr‑whirr when bag and grin reunite.

name: Plug Pug
description: Plug Pug is a pocket-plush outlet scout with a glow nose and a roll-up power-strip scarf. It sniffs out shy sockets, guards your charger with two teeny traffic cones, and woofs a proud full bars when your phone dings back to life. Book this snorty sparker for layover boosts, cable cuddles, and heroic tail-wag voltage vibes.

name: Snack Yak
description: Snack Yak is a palm-sized fuzzy yak with marshmallow horns and a mini saddle of tiny treat pouches. It barters pretzels for cookies with solemn nods, tracks beverage-cart orbits, and hums “crinkle diplomacy” while guarding your last gummy bear. Book this munch mediator for aisle-friendly nibble swaps, crumb control, and a triumphant tiny snort when you snag the elusive ginger ale.

name: Gate Gopher
description: Gate Gopher is a pocket-plush navigator with a neon vest, button-nose compass, and a fold-out felt flag that points where your feet should go. It scampers ahead, sniffing out gate changes with little 'sniff-scan!' squeaks, then waggles its flag and does a victory shuffle. Book this zigzag buddy for terminal treasure-map vibes and a triumphant tiny ding-ding when you arrive at the right door with time to wiggle.

name: Kiosk Kiwi
description: Kiosk Kiwi is a palm-sized plush bird with a buttony beak-boop and suction-cup toes that cling to check-in screens. It pecks out bag tags, smooths passport corners with a proud little “peep,” and tilts its felt head like a tiny concierge until your QR glows green. Book this chirpy kiosk coach for print-no-panic vibes and a triumphant teeny peep-peep when your tags curl out perfect.

name: Quokka O'Clock
description: Quokka O'Clock is a pocket-plush time coach with a clock-face tummy and flip-up felt sundial ears. It winks at jet lag, taps your wrist with its watch-tail when it's 'snooze o'clock,' and leads goofy gate stretches that reset your body clock with giggles. Book this smiley scheduler for timezone-taming cuddles and a triumphant tiny tick-tock when your yawns line up with local sunrise.

name: Seat Squirrel
description: Seat Squirrel is a palm-sized cabin tidier with acorn-clipboard paws and a whisk-broom tail that whooshes crumbs like confetti. It sorts your seat-pocket into now, later, and treasure, tucks your pen behind a felt ear, and squeaks ta-da! when it unearths a long-lost mint. Book this pocket organizer for clutter-calming cuddles and a triumphant tiny chitter when your row looks showroom ready.

name: Carousel Koala
description: Carousel Koala is a palm-sized baggage buddy with velvety fur, a magnet nose that clings to your suitcase handle, and felt binoculars for spin surveillance. It taps a leaf-shaped clipboard, murmurs “roundy-round recon,” then throws a mini paw parade when your bag appears. Book this spin-savvy snuggler for claim-line giggles and a triumphant tiny “koal-yeah!” at first sight.

name: WiFi Wombat
description: WiFi Wombat is a palm-sized plush hotspot hunter with velcro paws and foam antenna ears. It snuggles onto your tray table, sniffs for the strongest signal, and does a tiny 'bar-raising boogie' when your network pops to full. Book this cuddle connector for scroll-without-sulk vibes and a triumphant teeny 'ping!' when your maps load faster than your snacks disappear.

name: Compass Corgi
description: Compass Corgi is a pocket-plush gate guide with a twirling compass collar and stubby paws that point left or “left-er.” It trots beside your carry-on, boops confusing signs with its nose, and does a triumphant teeny tail helicopter when you reach the right gate without a goose chase. Book this directional darling for wander-without-worry vibes and a proud tiny “arf!” when the arrow matches your stride.

name: Snack Yak
description: Snack Yak is a pocket-plush nibble navigator with fuzzy horns and a tiny menu megaphone. It sniffs out the right munchies for your mood, sorts cravings into sweet, salty, or “surprise,” and applauds with a teensy “yak-yeah!” when you pick the perfect bite. Book this snack coach for wander-without-hanger vibes and giggly taste-testing between gates.

name: Queue Quokka
description: Queue Quokka is a pocket-plush line cheerleader with a sticker sheet and a tiny 'wiggle meter' clipboard. It beams its famous quokka grin, shimmies when the rope inches forward, and hands out “You got this!” mini badges for patience points. Book this smiley sidekick for wait-without-worry vibes and a squeaked 'quok-ok!' when it's finally your turn.

name: Nap Narwhal
description: Nap Narwhal is a pocket-plush rest scout with a knit blanket cape and a glow-tipped horn that flips to a tiny Do Not Disturb flag. It sniffs out the quietest corners, hums soft sea-snooze tunes, and gives a proud little narf when you snag the comfiest spot before boarding. Book this dreamy drift buddy for snooze-without-chaos vibes and power-nap glory between gates.
